records.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saq_versions" ( version INT );

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saq_jobs" ( key TEXT PRIMARY KEY, lock_key SERIAL NOT NULL, job BYTEA NOT NULL, queue TEXT NOT NULL, status TEXT NOT NULL, priority SMALLINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, group_key TEXT, scheduled BIGINT NOT NULL DEFAULT EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()), expire_at BIGINT );
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS saq_jobs_dequeue_idx ON "saq_jobs" (status, queue, scheduled);
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saq_stats" ( worker_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, stats JSONB, expire_at BIGINT );

ALTER TABLE "saq_stats" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS metadata JSONB; ALTER TABLE "saq_stats" ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS queue_key TEXT; CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS saq_stats_expire_at_idx ON "saq_stats" (expire_at); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS saq_stats_queue_key_idx ON "saq_stats" (queue_key);

CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS saq_jobs_status_queue_group_key_idx ON "saq_jobs" (status, queue, group_key); CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS saq_jobs_status_queue_priority_scheduled_idx ON "saq_jobs" (status, queue, priority, scheduled); DROP INDEX saq_jobs_dequeue_idx;

INSERT INTO "saq_jobs" ( key, job, queue, status, priority, group_key, scheduled ) VALUES ( %(key)s, %(job)s, %(queue)s, %(status)s, %(priority)s, %(group_key)s, %(scheduled)s ) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET job = %(job)s, queue = %(queue)s, status = %(status)s, priority = %(priority)s, group_key = %(group_key)s, scheduled = %(scheduled)s, expire_at = null WHERE "saq_jobs".status IN ('aborted', 'complete', 'failed') AND %(scheduled)s > "saq_jobs".scheduled RETURNING 1

INSERT INTO "saq_jobs" ( key, job, queue, status, priority, group_key, scheduled ) VALUES ( %(key)s, %(job)s, %(queue)s, %(status)s, %(priority)s, %(group_key)s, %(scheduled)s ) ON CONFLICT (key) DO UPDATE SET job = %(job)s, queue = %(queue)s, status = %(status)s, priority = %(priority)s, group_key = %(group_key)s, scheduled = %(scheduled)s, expire_at = null WHERE "saq_jobs".status IN ('aborted', 'complete', 'failed') AND %(scheduled)s > "saq_jobs".scheduled RETURNING 1
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS "saq_versions" ( version INT );

WITH locked_job AS ( SELECT key FROM "saq_jobs" WHERE status = 'queued' AND queue = %(queue)s AND %(now)s >= scheduled AND priority BETWEEN %(plow)s AND %(phigh)s AND group_key NOT IN ( SELECT DISTINCT group_key FROM "saq_jobs" WHERE status = 'active' AND queue = %(queue)s AND group_key IS NOT NULL ) ORDER BY priority, scheduled LIMIT %(limit)s FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED ) UPDATE "saq_jobs" SET status = 'active' FROM locked_job WHERE "saq_jobs".key = locked_job.key RETURNING job

INSERT INTO "saq_stats" (worker_id, stats, queue_key, metadata, expire_at) VALUES (%(worker_id)s, %(stats)s, %(queue_key)s, %(metadata)s, EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) + %(ttl)s) ON CONFLICT (worker_id) DO UPDATE SET stats = %(stats)s, queue_key = %(queue_key)s, metadata = %(metadata)s, expire_at = EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW()) + %(ttl)s
-- Delete expired jobs DELETE FROM "saq_jobs" WHERE queue = %(queue)s AND status IN ('aborted', 'complete', 'failed') AND %(now)s >= expire_at;
-- Delete expired stats DELETE FROM "saq_stats" WHERE %(now)s >= expire_at;
SELECT key, job, status FROM "saq_jobs" WHERE queue = %(queue)s AND status IN ('active', 'aborting');
